Yuan She's assassins are as numerous as clouds, and when they kill, no one knows who ordered it. The thought should chill you.

units.zh: 涉治塚捨，奢僭逾制，罪惡暴著，主上知之。
units.en: Yuan's tomb mansion breaks sumptuary law—one memorial and the throne will hear.
units.literal: Yuan She's managing tomb lodges exceeds regulation in luxury and usurpation; guilt and evil are openly manifest—the sovereign will learn of it.

units.zh: 今為君計，莫若墮壞涉塚捨，條奏其舊惡，君必得真令。
units.en: Smash his shrine, list his crimes, and you will win the real post.
units.literal: Now for your plan, nothing is better than demolishing Yuan She's tomb lodges and memorializing his old evils—you are sure to obtain a true prefectship.

units.zh: 如此，涉亦不敢怨矣。」
units.en: Thus Yuan She would not dare resent you, either."
units.literal: Thus Yuan She would not dare bear resentment either."

units.zh: 尹公如其計，莽果以為真令。
units.en: Yin followed the advice; Wang Mang gave him the full prefecture.
units.literal: Yin acted according to his plan; Mang indeed made him true prefect.

units.zh: 涉由此怨王游公，選賓客，遣長子初從車二十乘劫王游公家。
units.en: Yuan She then sent his son Chu at the head of twenty wagons to sack Wang Yougong's house.
units.literal: Yuan She thereby resented Wang Yougong, selected guests, and sent his eldest son Chu with twenty chariots to raid Wang Yougong's house.

units.zh: 游公母即祁太伯母也，諸客見之皆拜，傳曰「無驚祁夫人」。
units.en: Yougong's mother was Qi Taibo's mother; the raiders bowed and shouted, "Spare Lady Qi!"
units.literal: Yougong's mother was also Taibo's mother; the guests on seeing her all bowed, passing word "Do not alarm Lady Qi."

units.zh: 遂殺游公父及子，斷兩頭去。
units.en: They killed Wang's father and son and rode off with two heads.
units.literal: Thereupon they killed Yougong's father and son, cut off the two heads, and left.

units.zh: 涉性略似郭解，外溫仁謙遜，而內隱好殺。
units.en: Yuan She's nature somewhat resembled Guo Xie's: outwardly warm, benevolent, modest, and yielding, he inwardly concealed a love of killing.
units.literal: Yuan She's nature was somewhat like Guo Xie—outwardly warm, benevolent, and modest, while inwardly he concealed a love of killing.

units.zh: 睚眥於塵中，觸死者甚多。
units.en: Petty slights in the street left a trail of corpses.
units.literal: Over a sidelong glance in the dust, those who touched death were very many.

units.zh: 王莽末，東方兵起，諸王子弟多薦涉能得士死，可用。
units.en: Late in Wang Mang's reign eastern rebels rose; princelings urged hiring Yuan She for his suicide squads.
units.literal: At the end of Wang Mang, eastern armies rose; many of the princes' sons recommended Yuan She as able to obtain knights who would die for him—usable.

units.zh: 莽乃召見，責以罪惡，赦貰，拜鎮戎大尹天水太守。
units.en: Wang Mang summoned him, rebuked him for his crimes, then pardoned him and appointed him grand administrator of Zhenrong, Wang Mang's name for Tianshui Commandery.
units.literal: Mang thereupon summoned and saw him, rebuked him for crimes and evils, pardoned and forgave him, and appointed him Grand Guardian of the Pacified Rong and Grand Administrator of Tianshui.

units.zh: 涉至官無幾，長安敗，郡縣諸假號起兵攻殺二千石長吏以應漢。
units.en: He had barely taken office when Chang'an fell and every pretender army murdered Han magistrates.
units.literal: Not long after Yuan She reached office, Chang'an fell; commanderies and counties bearing false titles rose in arms, attacking and killing two-thousand-shi chief officials to respond to Han.

units.zh: 諸假號素聞涉名，爭問原尹何在，拜謁之。
units.en: The rebel chiefs had long heard Yuan She's name and vied to learn where Prefect Yuan was so they could pay their respects to him.
units.literal: Those bearing false titles had long heard Yuan She's name and vied to ask where Prefect Yuan was so they could pay their respects to him.

units.zh: 時莽州牧使者依附涉者皆得活。
units.en: At the time, all of Wang Mang's provincial governors and envoys who attached themselves to Yuan She were spared.
units.literal: At the time Mang's shepherds and envoys who attached to Yuan She all survived.

units.zh: 傳送致涉長安，更始西屏將軍申徒建請涉與相見，大重之。
units.en: They convoyed him to Chang'an where Shentu Jian, Gengshi's western-screen general, courted him.
units.literal: Escorted, he was delivered to Chang'an; Gengshi's General of the Western Screen Shentu Jian asked to see Yuan She and greatly esteemed him.

units.zh: 故茂陵令尹公壞涉塚捨者為建主簿，涉本不怨也。
units.en: The old prefect Yin who had smashed his tomb-shrine now served as Shentu Jian's chief clerk—Yuan bore him no malice.
units.literal: Former Maoling Magistrate Yin who had destroyed Yuan She's tomb lodges served as Jian's chief clerk; Yuan She originally bore no grudge.

units.zh: 涉從建所出，尹公故遮拜涉，謂曰：「易世矣，宜勿復相怨！」
units.en: Yin blocked his path, bowed, and said, "Times have turned—we should bury the feud."
units.literal: When Yuan She came out from Jian's place, Yin deliberately intercepted and bowed to Yuan She, saying: "The age has changed; it is fitting not to bear mutual resentment again!"

units.zh: 涉曰：「尹君，何一魚肉涉也！」
units.en: Yuan She said, "Lord Yin, how could you treat me like fish on the chopping block!"
units.literal: Yuan She said: "Lord Yin, how could you treat me like fish on the chopping block!"

units.zh: 涉用是怒，使客刺殺主簿。
units.en: For this Yuan She was angry and had a guest stab and kill the chief clerk.
units.literal: For this Yuan She was angry and had a guest stab and kill the chief clerk.

units.zh: 涉欲亡去，申徒建內恨恥之，陽言「吾欲與原巨先共鎮三輔，豈以一吏易之哉！」
units.en: Yuan She planned to flee. Shentu Jian, inwardly resentful and ashamed, put on a show of saying, "I intend to guard the Three Adjuncts together with Yuan Juxian. How could I trade him for a single clerk?"
units.literal: Yuan She planned to flee. Shentu Jian inwardly resented the humiliation and made a show of saying: "I intend to guard the Three Adjuncts together with Yuan Juxian. How could I trade him for a single clerk?"

units.zh: 賓客通言，令涉自系獄謝，建許之。
units.en: Clients relayed the word: Yuan She should bind himself in prison to apologize; Jian granted it.
units.literal: Guests conveyed the word, ordering Yuan She to bind himself in prison to apologize; Jian granted it.

units.zh: 賓客車數十乘共送涉至獄。
units.en: Dozens of wagons escorted him to jail.
units.literal: Several tens of chariots of guests together escorted Yuan She to prison.

units.zh: 建遣兵道徼取涉於車上，送車分散馳，遂斬涉，懸之長安市。
units.en: Shentu Jian's soldiers snatched him from his carriage, scattered his friends, and spiked his head in the Chang'an market.
units.literal: Jian sent troops to intercept and seize Yuan She from the chariot; the escort chariots scattered and galloped off; thereupon he beheaded Yuan She and hung him in the Chang'an market.

units.zh: 自哀、平間，郡國處處有豪桀，然莫足數。
units.en: Between Emperors Ai and Ping bravos sprouted in every province, few worth naming.
units.literal: From between Ai and Ping, commanderies and kingdoms everywhere had fierce champions, yet none worth counting.

units.zh: 其名聞州郡者，霸陵杜君敖、池陽韓幼孺、馬領繡君賓、西河漕中叔，皆有謙退之風。
units.en: Men like Du Jun'ao of Baling, Han Youru of Chiyang, Xiu Junbin of Maling, and Cao Zhongshu of Xihe were famous yet courteous.
units.literal: Those whose names were heard in provinces and commanderies—Du Jun'ao of Baling, Han Youru of Chiyang, Xiu Junbin of Maling, Cao Zhongshu of Xihe—all had modest yielding bearing.

units.zh: 王莽居懾，誅鋤豪俠，名捕漕中叔，不能得。
units.en: Wang Mang's purge named Cao Zhongshu, who vanished.
units.literal: When Wang Mang held the regency, he extirpated fierce knights and by name sought Cao Zhongshu but could not obtain him.

units.zh: 素善強弩將軍孫建，莽疑建藏匿，泛以問建。
units.en: He was tight with General Sun Jian; Wang Mang suspected Jian of hiding him and pressed the general.
units.literal: He had long been on good terms with Strong Crossbow General Sun Jian; Mang suspected Jian of hiding him and broadly questioned Jian.

units.zh: 建曰：「臣名善之，誅臣足以塞責。」
units.en: Sun Jian said, "Execute me and your account is closed."
units.literal: Jian said: "Your subject is on good terms with him; killing your subject would suffice to stop responsibility.

units.zh: 莽性果賊，無所容忍，然重建，不竟問，遂不得也。
units.en: Wang Mang was vicious but prized Sun Jian, dropped the probe, and never caught Cao.
units.literal: Mang's nature was indeed ruthless and could tolerate nothing, yet he valued Jian and did not pursue the question to the end, so in the end he did not get him.

units.zh: 中叔子少游，復以俠聞於世雲。
units.en: Cao son Shaoyou won a knightly name in his turn, they say.
units.literal: Zhongshu's son Shaoyou was again heard in the world for knight-errantry, it is said.
